intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Annapurna Circuit is one of the greatest treks in Nepal. This classic circuit trek is an incredibly varied and extraordinarily beautiful journey. Dramatic deep gorges, high mountain passes, Buddhist temples, ethnic Tibetan peoples, picturesque farming villages and all the major mountains of the Annapurna Massif.

highlights.title: Acclimatization Days
highlights.body: On this itinerary, we schedule an acclimatization day of rest to help facilitate our adjustment to the high altitudes encountered throughout the trek. On this day, we will take it easy, go for a walk to explore Manang, and go to bed early to prepare for the challenging ascent up Thorong pass.

highlights.title: Mountain Flights
highlights.body: There are two short mountain flights on this itinerary. The first takes you from Jomson to Pokhara and the second from Pohkara to Kathmandu. These small flights are a quintessential element to travel within Nepal.

cards.title: What to expect in Kathmandu
cards.body: You may have started this journey with an interest in the mountains of Nepal but no trip is complete without a good experience in Kathmandu. From the moment you meet your guide at the airport in Kathmandu, you are in good hands. There is no need to navigate the airport scene or figure out how to find your hotel in the back alleys of Boudha or Thamel. Don't worry, there is ample opportunity to get out and explore. You will be able to immerse yourself in the bustling network of alleys, streets, and buildings as you take in the city. Our guides, however, take care of the details so you can take in the surroundings. Your time in Kathmandu will also include good food, getting to know your guide, and an orientation for the trek. By the time we depart the city, everyone will be prepared for the mountains and your cultural curiosity will have been stoked.

cards.title: Besisahar and Chame
cards.body: This trek begins with an overland drive to Besisahar by jeep. Besisahar is district headquarter of Lamjung District in Gandaki province Nepal. We also drive to Chame which is the headquarters of Manang district through the Marshysngdi river. The trek proper begins here, crossing and recrossing the gorge carved by the Marshyangdi River on suspension bridges before you reach Manang, the largest village on the route.

cards.title: Thorong Pass
cards.body: Thorong high camp and the pass itself (5416m or 17,769ft) is the true physical test of this itinerary. From there you descend progressively with plenty of up and down along the way until you reach Jomsom.

cards.title: Pokhara
cards.body: Pokhara is the second most populous city in Nepal but it is very different when compared to Kathmandu. It is located on the shore of Phewa Lake. Three of the world's ten highest mountains (Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I and Manaslu) are within 35 miles of the valley, though Pokhara is only 822m or 2696ft above sea level.
